a.lede: In the first public statement since his resignation, Nvidia founder Jensen Huang signaled his willingness to return as CEO.
a.title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if allowed to return as Nvidia CEO

b.lede: The former CEO offered to return to his top role at the company after his resignation last week.
b.title: Nvidia says it doesn’t plan to reappoint Jensen Huang as CEO
